assets.name: fx-flight-stone-v1
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D game projectile animation sprite atlas for a top-down fantasy dungeon tower defense. Create ONE landscape PNG, 1536 by 1024, a perfectly regular SIX COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS grid: 24 equal 256 by 256 cells, no gaps, no visible grid. Each row is a different projectile; columns 1 through 6 are six successive animation frames of that SAME projectile. Transparent alpha background everywhere outside each projectile and its soft glow. Absolutely no backdrop, checkerboard, text, labels, watermark, border, tower, character, floor, or UI. Center every sprite exactly at its cell center, never cross cell borders. All projectiles travel horizontally toward RIGHT, their trails point LEFT. Keep the core centered in each frame; animate only rotation, glow, particles, and trail shape, not the center position. Original polished hand-painted 2.5D fantasy game art with crisp readable silhouettes, stone and metal texture, luminous magical details. Each cell has generous transparent padding; actual projectile with trail fits safely within cell, about 180 to 210 px wide. Four rows described below, in exact order.
ROW 1: BASIC CANNON. One round dark iron cannonball with a small orange hot rim and short smoky orange tail. Six frames of gently varying fire and smoke; clearly round metallic core.
ROW 2: TWIN STONE CANNON. One SINGLE squared granite stone shell, chunky cube with bevels and a short dusty white-gray tail. Do NOT draw two shells in a cell: the game will duplicate the single shell into a twin volley. Six frames of slight cube rotation and dust.
ROW 3: NEEDLE TOWER. One very slender silver needle dart, sharp point at RIGHT, tiny brass collar near the back, fine short white air lines. Thin straight dart silhouette; no round core. Six subtle shimmer frames.
ROW 4: PEBBLE CANNON. One irregular small brown gravel pebble with two or three tiny airborne gravel flecks and tan dusty trail. Clearly rounded irregular brown pebble rather than squared gray granite. Six frames of visible pebble tumbling.
